scope: Read-only benchmark of selected thesis/evidence/valuation pages, not a full re-underwriting of historical investments

judgment: Credible student investment-pitch format with clean layout and careful financial mechanics. Strongest examples better link differentiated operational evidence to forecasts and explain why the entry price rewards risk. No justified claim of top-tier thesis or winning probability.

priority_fixes.detail: Same model gives51.29 December2026 planning value versus52.22 reference entry and77.68 December2030 target. Need explicit required-return/entry-price rationale; no invented margin of safety.
Map evidence to disputed assumption, consistent forecast comparison and cash/value impact. Mix decomposition is conditional arithmetic rather than independent support of future CPU economics.

priority_fixes.issue: Original research must bear on recommendation
priority_fixes.detail: Oracle billing audit is useful but neither a matched workload test nor proof of chip pricing power. Link it to an actual modeling decision or prioritize direct pricing/cost/capacity evidence.

gtx_review.lesson: Co-development duration and awarded revenue support cash visibility; scenario assumptions connect operating case to valuation.
gtx_review.caution: Page10 claim that institutional holders eliminate harmful management behavior is not established by ownership. Winning deck is not a validated investment forecast.
